content: सामन्त {%a.%} .²1 Bordering, bounding, neighbouring. .²2 Universal. .{@-तः@} .²1 A neighbour; राष्ट्रेषु रक्षाधिकृतान् सामन्तांश्चैव चोदितान् <ls>Ms. 9. 272</ls>. .²2 A neighbouring king. .²3 A feudatory or tributary prince; सामन्तमौलिमणिरञ्जितपादपीठम् <ls>V. 3. 19</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 28</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 33</ls>. .²4 A prince with a revenue of 3 lacs Karṣa; सामन्तः स नृपः प्रोक्तो यावल्लक्षत्रयावधि <ls>Śukra. 1. 83</ls>. .²5 A leader, general. .{@-तम्@} Neighbourhood.
